events.verdict: Dinwiddie (DAL) engages and quickly disengages with Barnes (SAS) as they each attempt to establish rebounding position.
Fox (SAS) brushes Marshall's (DAL) front during his upward shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Barnes (SAS) closes out toward Dinwiddie (DAL) and any contact after Dinwiddie's release is marginal.
Marshall (DAL) shifts his body as he contests Castle's (SAS) driving shot attempt, but avoids initiating any illegal contact.
Johnson (SAS) and Edwards (DAL) get their arms tangled during the rebound.
Castle (SAS) and Edwards (DAL) each make clean contact with the ball prior to any incidental contact occurring during the rebound.
Johnson (SAS) gains control of the rebound as simultaneous marginal contact occurs with Edwards' (DAL) back and head.
Vassell (SAS) drives through Edwards (DAL) and initiates contact that causes Edwards to become dislodged as he sets the screen.
Martin (DAL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Fox (SAS) as the pass is made.
Barnes (SAS) brings his hands forward toward Thompson (DAL) and the contact with Thompson's upper body is marginal.
Castle (SAS) moves forward into Marshall (DAL) and initiates body contact that affects Marshall's SQBR after he receives the pass.
Edwards (DAL) raises his right arm up to pursue the rebound and incidental contact occurs with Vassell's (SAS) right arm.
Marshall (DAL) and Barnes (SAS) make incidental arm contact with one another as they each attempt to gain control of the rebound.
Vassell (SAS) commits a take foul on Thompson (DAL).
Barnes (SAS) releases his off-arm away from Edwards' (DAL) front and the contact as Barnes shifts his momentum at the top of the perimeter is marginal.
Edwards (DAL) legally contests Barnes' (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Fox (SAS) commits a take foul on Marshall (DAL).
